_comment: One PUT /api/v1/settings/skills per entry. Skills are git-only — TrueForge sparse-clones url+path@ref into the sandbox. There is no file upload.
_names: Each `name` MUST match a value in SKILL_MAP in services/advisory-service/app/main.py, because that is what pool-monitor puts on the task payload.
_repo: Replace ${SKILLS_REPO_URL} with the repo you push config/skills-repo/ to.
